limitations: These source speakers were inner validation used for epoch/LR selection; this is a descriptive sensitivity diagnostic, not independent generalization.
Gain normalization inside encoders may suppress simple gain changes; no claim about microphones, rooms or device hardware robustness.
Synthetic additive white noise does not reproduce real room noise, reverberation, clipping, or mobile microphone processing.
Forced canonical CTC occupancy can move even if the intended utterance is unchanged; it is not a verified produced-phone boundary.
Common attenuation may accompany noise to avoid clipping; measured SNR uses the equally attenuated original signal and is reported after PCM16 quantization.
Human ratings are intentionally absent from transformed results; changed probabilities do not establish pronunciation changes or correctness.
Five-rater score distribution models are not validated child-SSD pronunciation judges, and ages2-5 are absent.
Argmax tie handling selects the lowest index and is used only for descriptive class-change counts, never learner feedback.
measurements: expected rating signed and absolute shift
canonical occupancy and pooling window movement in frames
source/derived PCM RMS, peak, rail count, DC, near-silence fraction
nominal and measured whole-waveform SNR, common attenuation
original cached CTC/scalar/window/phonetic vector/saved prediction parity
noise: One source-audio-hash-seeded, zero-mean Gaussian draw shared between SNR levels; exact whole-waveform RMS scaling before common attenuation and PCM16 quantization
parityFailurePolicy: Fail closed with measured maximum difference; investigate without post-hoc tolerance relaxation. All original windows and target identities must match exactly.
peakHandling: If clean+noise peak exceeds0.98, attenuate BOTH clean and noise by0.98/peak. Preserve relative SNR; disclose common gain. No waveform clipping or trimming. Original source WAV is copied byte-for-byte.
reporting: Per target, per clip/speaker, and all-target weighted descriptive shifts. No independent-sample CI from5-8speakers. No accuracy, NLL, Brier or calibration against original ratings on any transformed audio.
selection: SHA256(seed:speaker:speakerId) ascending; then SHA256(seed:clip:clipId) ascending within each selected speaker; all available if fewer than eight; age6-12 metadata only, no rating/confidence/duration selection
